headline: Google unveils Gemini 4 Argon, restricts access to vetted experts
summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon, which it bills as its most capable model yet for coding, enterprise knowledge work and cybersecurity defense. Rather than a general release, the company is limiting access to a vetted group of cybersecurity experts, citing safety concerns and the risk of misuse by hackers.
